# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan and platform expansion**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a new Vulkan/Silk.NET package and expands platform support to Nano Server and container targets. A new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package brings Vulkan surface integration. Nano Server gains font rendering via FreeType. Performance and memory fixes round out the release.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — Adds a new NuGet package that wires up a Vulkan rendering surface through the Silk.NET abstraction, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — Font rendering on Windows Nano Server now works by using FreeType as the font backend, resolving a long-standing gap where no fonts were available on that minimal image. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server container images, ensuring the library works correctly across these lightweight runtime environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Solution files migrated to .slnx format** — All .sln solution files have been converted to the new .slnx format, aligning with modern .NET SDK tooling. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))

## Bug Fixes

- **Memory leak fixed in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was not freed when the native raster image creation failed, causing a memory leak on every failed call to SKImage.Create. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Eliminated unnecessary string allocation in GetEncodedText** — The null-terminated text path in GetEncodedText no longer creates an intermediate string, reducing allocations in hot text-rendering loops. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized at creation** — The internal uniform lookup map is now allocated at the correct capacity up front, avoiding repeated rehashing when a runtime effect has many uniforms. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
